data.title: ANALYSIS | As Trump declares ceasefire over, Iran's leadership is divided over how it wants the war to end | CBC News
data.description: On Wednesday, U.S. President Donald Trump said the ceasefire with Iran was effectively over, and called the country's leadership "scum." His comments come in the midst of Iran’s weeklong funeral for former supreme leader Ali Khamenei, who was killed by U.S.-Israeli airstrikes in February.
